name: A finished step branches into the next pick
looks: A checked, completed node sits at the left under the line "It learns, then picks your next test." Thin lines branch out from it to a short list of dim candidate labels; a beat later, one candidate bolds and fills solid while the rest stay faint, as the system's pick for what comes next.
build: Branch lines draw on (`strokeDashoffset`) with a light 40-60ms stagger; all candidates start dim and thin. The chosen one tweens to full opacity and a bolder fill with a touch of scale (1 -> 1.06) over 200-300ms, landing after the lines finish so the pick reads as its own beat.
sound: A soft whoosh per branch line, a distinct confirming tick exactly as the chosen candidate bolds.
prompt: From one completed, checked step, branch thin lines out to a short list of dim candidate next options, then let one of them bold and solidify a beat later as the system's pick, so the recommendation reads as a considered decision rather than a random highlight.
